description.p: mb3d-rs is Mandelbulb3D (MB3D), the 3D fractal program, rewritten so that it runs on today's computers: on Linux, Windows and macOS, and with the picture calculated on the graphics card where MB3D could only use the processor. It opens MB3D's parameter files (.m3p, .m3i, text parameters from forums), uses MB3D's formulas and maps, and makes the same pictures.

The windows are MB3D's own: the main window, Formulas, Lighting, Post processing, Navigator, Animation, Batch, Big renders, Monte Carlo, Voxel export, Bulb Tracer 2, MutaGen and the rest. If you know MB3D, you know this program, and MB3D's tutorials apply.

ul.li: Ray marching, shadows, ambient occlusion and reflections on the graphics card (Vulkan), with the processor's cores sharing the work
MB3D's formulas, including the hundreds written in machine code, run on the card and on the processor
Monte Carlo path tracing with a neural noise filter (Intel Open Image Denoise, on the processor in this package)
Animations, big tiled renders, voxel and mesh export, a swarm of computers sharing one picture
Interfaces in several languages, themes, and the mb3d command line renderer for scripts (flatpak run --command=mb3d io.github.thr32423.mb3d-rs)

description.p: The History window behind the title bar's clock icon: every picture calculated with its thumbnail and every file opened or saved, as a list, rows or tiles; a lighting change only repaints, as in Mandelbulb3D; a formula that never returns no longer slows a render to a crawl.
Safe Rust throughout except the C library and the JIT, a card listed twice in a Flatpak sandbox counted once, the files of the Flatpak.
